english_source_note: Uniform Distribution mod 1 and Weyl's Criterion
statement_en: If for every positive integer $h$, the sequence $u_{n+h}-u_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$, then $u_n$ is also uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
key_techniques: reduction of equidistribution to shifted differences
callout_body: 如果序列$u_{n+h}-u_n$是模1均匀分布的对任意正整数$h$成立，那么$u_n$也是模1均匀分布的。
